normalMaps: Approximate smooth head, torso and limb surfaces, aligned to the existing atlas frames
materials: R=response, G=specular, B=feature protection; alpha matches the source sheet

occlusion.channels: R=barrier height, G=room ambient, B=structural ambient

wallSurfaces.ambient: continuous room ambient across ends and junctions

doorSurfaces.normals: cached per face, independent of neighbouring sprites
doorSurfaces.ambient: inherits adjoining room, including the floor footprint
